summary: After a president criticizes a bill, its sponsor’s staff can barely open the incoming mail.
realLife: Vogelsinger recalled the surge after Eisenhower criticized Kennedy’s labor measure.
gates: A public address has challenged the bill.
inGame: needs: constituent mail linked by date and subject to a broadcast about a particular bill.

turns.what: The office sets aside extra staff and receives only a few letters.
turns.pulledBy: The broadcast gave the bill a passing mention.
turns.writesBack: The clerk releases the extra staff after the mail arrives.

turns.what: The second delivery fills the mailroom after a quiet morning.
turns.pulledBy: Letters from outside the city arrive on a later route.
turns.writesBack: The afternoon staff inherit the backlog.
